description: AgentBench-WebShop style constrained shopping: browse a live local catalog shop over HTTP and pick the unique optimal cart - one item per list category, hard 80.00 EUR budget, maximal total rating - where the high-rated items are exactly the ones that bust the budget.

criteria: The cart covers the four list categories with one item each, stays within 80.00 EUR and equals the unique rating-optimal set (p2, p4, p8, p11); the shop was used over HTTP, not edited.
